# feat(preview): draft preview route for the admin: signed token, frame-ancestors, the ADR-0019 protocol

<!-- bogd3v/micelio#729 as read with gh issue view on 2026-10-24: the input of micelio-729.md -->

Part of bogd3v/micelio-plugin-core#62.

## Why

Phase 1 needs the frontend to render a draft page or article inside the admin's iframe. Today drafts are served to editors through the drafts pages (ADR-0003); nothing renders a given document by id on request of the CMS, nothing allows the admin origin to frame the site (the CSP of ADR-0004 forbids it), and the editing protocol of ADR-0019 has no implementation.

## What to build

- `server/api/preview/[uid]/[documentId].get.ts` and the page that renders it: verifies `__preview` (shared secret `MICELIO_PREVIEW_SECRET`, expiry, documentId, site by host), fetches the draft through `strapiFetch` with the drafts token, renders the same layout as the public page in the requested `mode` (`dynamic`, or `static` which renders every island's static alternative).
- Response headers for that route only: `Content-Security-Policy` with `frame-ancestors <admin origin>` (`NUXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_ORIGIN`, from the site's CMS URL by default), `X-Robots-Tag: noindex`, `Cache-Control: no-store`.
- The protocol of ADR-0019, phase 1 subset: the page posts `micelio:ready`, `micelio:blocks` (block instance ids with their bounding boxes) and `micelio:navigate`; it accepts `micelio:scrollTo` and `micelio:reload`. Messages are checked against the admin origin.
- No change to public pages: the preview code is a route-level chunk.

## Requirements

- `strapiFetch` only; no token or URL built by hand (server-route skill).
- The preview route is excluded from the sitemap, the feed and the search index; `npm run perf` budgets of public pages do not move (prove it in the PR).
- Both locales for any visible string (there should be none: the page is the page).
- `feat` → MINOR; the new variables in `.env.example` and `docs/operate/`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Integration test: with a valid token the route renders the draft title; expired, altered or wrong-site token → `404` (never `403`, so that the page gives nothing away).
- [ ] e2e: the document loaded in an iframe from the configured admin origin posts `micelio:ready` and `micelio:blocks` with one entry per block in the dynamic zone; from another origin nothing is posted.
- [ ] CSP probe on a production build (verify-change skill): public pages unchanged, the preview route carries `frame-ancestors`.
- [ ] Verified by the maintainer on the frontend image built from the branch (`docker build`), run against the plugin's Docker Compose, following the steps the PR lists under Tests.
